events.title: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume work
events.title_zh: Anthropic 发布面向高吞吐任务的 Claude Haiku 5.5
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 across its API, apps, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. The model has a 1M-token context window and targets summaries, compaction, classification, customer support, browser use and coding subagents. Standard pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens up to 100K prompt tokens, with five-times rates above that threshold.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 API、应用、AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5。模型提供 100 万 token 上下文，面向摘要、压缩、分类、客服、浏览器操作与编码 subagent。提示不超过 10 万 token 时，标准价为每百万输入 0.10 美元、输出 0.50 美元；超过阈值后价格为五倍。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams routing high-volume agent work, Haiku 5.5 sharply lowers the cost floor while keeping long context and broad cloud availability. The 100K price cliff and vendor-only quality claims make workload-specific evaluation essential.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对路由高吞吐 agent 任务的团队来说，Haiku 5.5 在保留长上下文和多云可用性的同时大幅降低成本底线。10 万 token 价格跳档和厂商单方质量主张要求团队按真实负载验证。

technical_details.price_under_100k: $0.10 input, $0.01 cache read, $0.125 cache write, $0.50 output per million tokens
technical_details.price_over_100k: $0.50 input, $0.05 cache read, $0.625 cache write, $2.50 output per million tokens
technical_details.availability: Anthropic API, Claude apps, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
technical_details.positioning: high-volume and latency-sensitive work; coding subagent

technical_details_zh.超过十万_token_价格: 每百万 token：输入 $0.50、缓存读取 $0.05、缓存写入 $0.625、输出 $2.50
technical_details_zh.可用性: Anthropic API、Claude 应用、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure
technical_details_zh.定位: 高吞吐与延迟敏感任务；编码 subagent

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用真实分类、压缩和 subagent 轨迹对比 Haiku 4.5，记录成功率、延迟与跨 10 万 token 的单任务成本。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare real classification, compaction and subagent traces with Haiku 4.5 on success, latency and per-task cost across the 100K threshold.

events.title: Liquid AI releases multimodal d1 decision models for edge devices
events.title_zh: Liquid AI 发布面向边缘设备的多模态 d1 决策模型
events.summary_en: Liquid AI released d1-3B and experimental d1-omni-600M weights for single-pass typed decisions instead of token generation. d1-3B accepts text and images; d1-omni adds text-image or text-audio inputs. Liquid reports 8 ms per decision on an RTX 4090 and 50 ms on Jetson Orin Nano for d1-3B, with public demos and code loaded through trust_remote_code.
events.summary_zh: Liquid AI 发布 d1-3B 与实验性的 d1-omni-600M 权重。它们不生成文本，而是一次前向计算返回带类型的决策。d1-3B 支持文本与图像；d1-omni 支持文本加图像或文本加音频。Liquid 报告 d1-3B 在 RTX 4090 上单次决策为 8 毫秒，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上为 50 毫秒，并开放 demo 与代码。
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, moderation and edge inspection, a compact model can move structured decisions off the generative path and reduce latency. The benchmarks are vendor-run, the custom LFM license needs review and trust_remote_code expands the execution boundary.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对路由、审核与边缘检测来说，小模型可以把结构化决策移出生成链路并降低延迟。benchmark 由厂商运行，自定义 LFM 许可需要审查，trust_remote_code 也扩大了执行边界。

technical_details.outputs: typed noul, choice and number decisions in one forward pass
technical_details.reported_latency: d1-3B: 8 ms RTX 4090, 9 ms AMD MI325X, 30 ms Apple M5 Pro, 50 ms Jetson Orin Nano
technical_details.reported_scores: Decision Index 0.2.1 48.57 for d1-3B; seven-dataset mean 82.9

technical_details_zh.输出: 一次前向计算返回 typed noul、choice 与 number 决策
technical_details_zh.厂商报告延迟: d1-3B：RTX 4090 8 ms、AMD MI325X 9 ms、Apple M5 Pro 30 ms、Jetson Orin Nano 50 ms
technical_details_zh.厂商报告成绩: d1-3B 的 Decision Index 0.2.1 为 48.57；七数据集均值 82.9

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在隔离环境用公开权重跑一组路由与图像审核任务，对比延迟、校准和生成模型成本。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run the public weights in isolation on routing and image-review tasks, comparing latency, calibration and generative-model cost.
